fixtures.reference: float32 input [0.25,-1,2,9] must return the same ordered values
batch values 1 and 2 must preserve shape metadata and exact identity output
A minimal supported TensorFlow graph with one input and one deterministic output
Calibration entries must be forwarded without mutation and produce a reviewed numeric result
Lifecycle, callback registration, negative ownership, and context cases use no model artifact

review.promotionRule: Only an independent review of a clean, authorized, source/package-bound record may promote a case to runtime-executed.

cases.synchronizationBoundary: factory and snapshot calls return synchronously
cases.copyBoundary: typed host values and shape metadata are copied into independent managed snapshots
cases.resourceOwnership: created arguments own native storage; shape snapshots do not borrow native memory
cases.resultCriteria: Scalar metadata is validated as a managed shape contract; native empty/generated arguments use the standard [1,4] fixture shape, while explicit-stride metadata remains an independent managed shape and clone values match.
cases.evidenceBoundary: Native detached arguments require static standard packed shapes, so explicit-stride coverage is limited to managed shape metadata while native empty/generated/clone behavior is exercised with standard shapes.

cases.synchronizationBoundary: Save/Load and clone return before the next managed access
cases.copyBoundary: loaded and cloned arguments remain valid after source disposal
cases.resourceOwnership: each loaded or cloned argument owns a new native handle and payload
cases.resultCriteria: Round-tripped argument values, cloned parameter maps, and cloned output collections remain exact after their source owners are disposed.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The reviewed candidate executed Save, Load, Clone, and value readback, but did not prove clone use after source disposal; the complete case remains runtime-deferred.

cases.publicSurface: MIGraphXTarget, MIGraphXCompileOptions, MIGraphXFileOptions, MIGraphXOnnxOptions, and MIGraphXProgram Clone
cases.synchronizationBoundary: assign-to returns before the destination is exposed
cases.copyBoundary: destination handle is independent from the source owner
cases.resourceOwnership: destination is created before assign-to and disposed on every failure path
cases.resultCriteria: Target, compile, file, ONNX, and program clones preserve their reviewed fields and remain usable for parse, compile, save, and metadata access after source disposal.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The reviewed candidate created every clone and compared selected fields, but did not verify every field, destination use after source disposal, or provider failure cleanup.

cases.synchronizationBoundary: module/instruction access completes while the program lease is held
cases.copyBoundary: borrowed graph metadata is copied before the native collection is released
cases.resourceOwnership: graph views retain a program lease and cannot outlive the parent program
cases.resultCriteria: Main and child module printing plus original/cloned module collections remain usable across caller disposal of the parent program.
cases.evidenceBoundary: Main and child module views remained usable after caller disposal of the parent program, but the complete borrowed metadata criteria remain runtime-deferred.

cases.synchronizationBoundary: each graph edit returns before the next edit or compile
cases.copyBoundary: argument and shape inputs are copied or retained by documented parent leases
cases.resourceOwnership: program owns edited graph state; managed views do not invent a module destroy owner
cases.resultCriteria: A managed add-zero graph containing parameter, literal, allocation, operation, and return edits compiles and exactly preserves the reviewed input values.
cases.evidenceBoundary: Parameter, allocation, return, and print edits executed, but the edited graph was not compiled and run; independent migraphx_module_create ownership remains excluded.

cases.synchronizationBoundary: TensorFlow parse returns before options or program disposal
cases.copyBoundary: strict UTF-8 paths, input shapes, dimensions, and output names are copied for the native call
cases.resourceOwnership: options and parsed program own separate native handles
cases.resultCriteria: File and buffer parses produce equivalent program shapes and deterministic output for the reviewed fixture.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The reviewed candidate executed file/buffer parse, compile, run, and output equivalence for one minimal GraphDef; an independent numerical reference and model variants remain unverified.

cases.publicSurface: MIGraphXQuantizeOpNames, MIGraphXQuantizeInt8Options, MIGraphXQuantizeFp8Options, and MIGraphXProgram quantization mutation
cases.synchronizationBoundary: option mutation and compile complete before output comparison
cases.copyBoundary: calibration map and option strings are copied into the native call
cases.resourceOwnership: quantization option clones own independent native option handles
cases.resultCriteria: Option forwarding, clone equality, and quantized numerical output match independently reviewed expectations.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The reviewed candidate executed INT8 and FP8 quantize-before-compile paths and observed finite outputs; numerical accuracy and performance remain unverified.

cases.synchronizationBoundary: context operation and lease release are serialized
cases.copyBoundary: queue identity is observed only while the context lease is alive
cases.resourceOwnership: context retains the parent program lease and releases it deterministically
cases.resultCriteria: Finish and queue calls complete without parent-program use-after-dispose or leaked context handles.
cases.evidenceBoundary: At the exact reviewed source/provider identity, Finish and non-null queue access completed after caller disposal of the compiled parent program; this does not establish queue portability, performance, or broader concurrency behavior.

cases.publicSurface: MIGraphXOperation.Create with MIGraphXOperationAttributes and operation Clone
cases.synchronizationBoundary: each materialized operation create and clone returns before the next operation is accessed
cases.copyBoundary: typed scalar and array values are formatted into one complete attribute object before the native call
cases.resourceOwnership: each operation and clone owns an independent native handle; no C vararg value is retained
cases.resultCriteria: reshape, transpose, slice, multibroadcast, and topk accept their reviewed typed attributes, expose the expected names, and produce independent clones.
cases.evidenceBoundary: At the exact reviewed source/provider identity, reshape, transpose, slice, multibroadcast, and topk creation and cloning passed; arbitrary format placeholders and general C variadic values remain unsupported.

cases.publicSurface: MIGraphXExperimentalCustomOp registration, copy/delete, callbacks, and Clone
cases.synchronizationBoundary: registration and callback setter calls return before disposal
cases.copyBoundary: managed state and delegate roots remain alive for native copy/delete and callback execution
cases.resourceOwnership: native custom-op owns callback state until delete; clones create and replay independent registrations
cases.resultCriteria: Callback invocations, exception conversion, copy/delete balance, and clone replay match the reviewed contract.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The reviewed candidate executed create, clone, and registration, but native callback invocation remained zero.

cases.synchronizationBoundary: managed rejection occurs before native clone
cases.copyBoundary: no borrowed device pointer is copied or escaped
cases.resourceOwnership: the borrowed argument remains owned by its external device lease
cases.resultCriteria: Clone rejects with the documented managed exception and leaves the source lease unchanged.
cases.evidenceBoundary: No official borrowed device argument or GPU memory clone-rejection path was executed.

cases.publicSurface: migraphx_operation_create general variadic attributes and MIGraphXOperation unrestricted construction
cases.synchronizationBoundary: no-attribute and fully materialized typed-attribute call shapes reach native; format placeholders and arbitrary variadic values are rejected before any native call
cases.copyBoundary: no guessed C variadic argument layout is emitted
cases.resourceOwnership: the restricted factories own and dispose their handles; unsupported format-placeholder and arbitrary-vararg calls create no owner
prerequisites: frozen C header and normalized manifest
cases.resultCriteria: The restricted factories and clone preserve operation ownership; typed materialized common attributes are serialized without variadic values, while arbitrary formatting and general varargs remain absent and the compatibility inventory keeps the general declaration unsupported.
cases.evidenceBoundary: A typed native ABI is required before exposing format placeholders or additional variadic values.

cases.synchronizationBoundary: no independent module owner is exposed
cases.copyBoundary: module views enter only through a program-owned lease
cases.resourceOwnership: the frozen header has no matching module destroy operation
cases.resultCriteria: The API does not expose an owner that cannot be deterministically disposed.
cases.evidenceBoundary: A matching destroy operation and reviewed native ownership contract are required.

cases.publicSurface: graph, context, custom-op, argument, and option Dispose under concurrent access
cases.synchronizationBoundary: all calls serialize with owner leases and Dispose
cases.copyBoundary: no result is read from a released native collection
cases.resourceOwnership: each owner reaches one terminal release without double-free
cases.resultCriteria: No deadlock, use-after-free, leaked owner, or unexpected native status occurs across repeated races.
cases.evidenceBoundary: Five bounded races completed in the reviewed candidate, but repeated real-runtime stress and leak observations remain deferred.

cases.publicSurface: LibraryImport and DllImport generated EntryPoint paths for the M12 wrappers
cases.synchronizationBoundary: the representative target framework completes the same native workflow
cases.copyBoundary: managed snapshots and copied argument values are identical across paths
cases.resourceOwnership: ABI path selection does not change handle lifetime or cleanup
cases.resultCriteria: At minimum net46, netcoreapp3.1, net7.0, and net10.0 produce equivalent real-runtime observations.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The reviewed official run used net10.0 only; representative DllImport and LibraryImport runtime equivalence remains deferred.
